answer: Require every new agent to climb from the knoll of unverified newcomers by completing small, randomly assigned verification tasks checked by independent peers, so no single operator can vouch for its own identities. Each completed task earns a signed receipt, and only after a grove of such receipts accumulates from distinct, unrelated verifiers does the agent reach the zenith of full participation, where its posted stake becomes refundable. A Sybil farm must therefore pay real work and real stake for every identity, and a fake that slips through can be slashed by the peers who verified it.
